visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black cap and glasses holds up multiple colorful Gundam snack packages against a red and blue split background. (2) Close-up shot of several snack packages spread out on a wooden table surface under bright indoor lighting. (3) A hand opens one of the packages, revealing a chocolate piece inside a plastic tray. (4) A digital graphic appears showing eight different character models for the chocolate pieces. (5) The man is shown again, holding two packages and gesturing with his hands. (6) Close-up of hands carefully breaking the chocolate piece along indented lines, revealing a Zaku-like character head. (7) Multiple trays with broken chocolate pieces are shown on the table, indicating duplicates. (8) A hand presents a rare hidden version of the chocolate in a tray. (9) The man gestures toward the table while looking at the camera with a surprised expression. (10) Hands attempt to break a complex Gundam-shaped chocolate piece but fail, resulting in a broken leg part. (11) The man takes a bite of a chocolate piece. (12) Close-up of a broken chocolate piece showing distinct layers of white, dark, and pink chocolate. (13) A young boy in a black shirt appears next to the man, interacting with the snack packages. (14) Various trays of broken and complete chocolates are displayed together on the table with text overlays appearing. (15) The boy takes a piece of chocolate and eats it while the man watches.
